name: AUV ABYSS
def: REMUS 6000 autonomous underwater vehicle built by Hydroid in 2008 and owned by GEOMAR, used to map the deep seabed and gather data from the water column.
facts: Named after the abyssal plain, the seafloor zone between 2000 and 6000 m
Runs on lithium ion batteries for dives of up to 22 hours
